messages:
Elena M.: Heads-up: updated billing & quota policy will roll out on June 1. Key points: introduced tiered soft rate limits, 7-day overage forgiveness for hosted metered plans, and shortened free-trial credit window to 90 days. Internal FAQ + sample invoices linked in the doc: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/june-rollout :mega:
Billing Bot: Published: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/june-rollout (includes CSV schema and sample rows)
Devex Team: Quick ask  can we add `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset` to headers so SDKs can backoff more intelligently?
Elena M.: Good call. Adding `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset` and `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Policy` to the header rollout list.
Josh R.: For customers on Reserved plans, confirm no change to committed billing or QoS?
Elena M.: Correct. Reserved/ Dedicated customers keep committed billing. Overage forgiveness only applies to hosted metered plans.
Marcus C.: Any change to invoice cadence or billing export frequency?
Elena M.: Monthly invoices remain. Were adding a consolidated monthly export (CSV) and a per-day token usage CSV for customers who request it.
Support Bot: Note: Update support playbooks for overage disputes and credit expiration questions.
Product Ops: Are we grandfathering existing trial credits?
Elena M.: Yes  all credits issued before the rollout are grandfathered to the old 180-day expiry. New credits after June 1 use 90-day expiry.
Devex Team: ETA on SDK changes? we need server headers surfaced and example retry logic.
Josh R.: Recommend code snippet for retries: ```
const backoff = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
if (resp.headers['x-redwood-ratelimit-remaining'] == '0') {
  await backoff(1000 * (parseInt(resp.headers['x-redwood-ratelimit-reset']) || 1));
}
```
Support Bot: Filing a ticket to update KB articles.
Marcus C.: Who owns price change comms for paid customers? Legal or RevOps?
Elena M.: RevOps is owner for billing comms; Legal is reviewing the customer-facing language now.
Devex Team: noted, will prep SDK PRs once headers are finalized. ETA May 20 for PRs in mono-repo.
Elena M.: AMA session scheduled: May 25 at 11:00 PT in All-Hands channel. Please review doc and send questions ahead.
Billing Bot: Reminder: rollout date June 1.
